eye: eye diameter (ED); left side for symmetrical characters per the Methods, where measured on the left
method: linear measurement of the type series with digital Mitutoyo CD-6 ASX Digimatic Calipers to the nearest 0.1 mm under a Nikon SMZ745 dissecting microscope, on the left side of preserved specimens for symmetrical characters when possible (Materials and methods, page-reader paraphrase); the Methods define 'eye diameter (ED, the maximum horizontal diameter of the eyeball)'; the Table 5 caption prints the unit ('Descriptive measurements in millimeters and characters of the type series of Cnemaspis samui sp. nov.')
conditions: Female of Cnemaspis samui sp. nov. Measured specimen: ZMKU R 00982, paratype, adult female. Type material as printed (page-reader pieces): holotype 'ZMKU R 00974, adult male' from Hin Lad Waterfall, Ang Thong Subdistrict, Ko Samui District, Surat Thani Province, Thailand, collected 19 June 2018; 'Seventeen paratypes (adult males = 14, adult females = 3).' Table 5 is laid out with specimens as columns (header row: Characters/Museum Number, then ZMKU R 00974, 00966, 00967, 00968, 00969, 00970, 00971, 00972, 00973, 00975, 00976, 00977, 00978, 00979, 00983, 00980, 00981, 00982) and characters as rows; Type (H holotype, P paratype) and Sex rows as returned give 15 males (holotype plus 14 paratypes) and 3 females (ZMKU R 00980-00982), matching the paratype count. The quote is the whole ED row with cells joined by single spaces; this specimen is the ZMKU R 00982 column. The Description gives ED only as a ratio ('eye large (ED/HL 0.21) with round pupil'). Cnemaspis similan, the paper's other new species, has no ED row in Table 5 and is not filed.
